description: Still-deployable historical Candidate using the exact official native LTX 1.6.1 distilled FP8 scaled-matmul path, spatial upscaler, and Gemma 3 companion closure. The FP8 checkpoint uses fp8-scaled-mm without CPU or disk offload because the pinned pipeline cannot stream this quantization policy; physical Spark acceptance remains pending. LTX-2.5 BF16 is the current fidelity baseline and LTX-2.5 FP8-cast is the current lower-memory canary; this execution contract remains available for reproducibility.
title: LTX-2 19B distilled FP8 native synchronized single Spark (superseded)
